title: AAB — the AI · Human Co-Development Studio
description: AAB (Ascension for All and Beyond) is a browser-first studio for AI-Human co-development of systems (not just software) under the Verification-Gated Human-AI Co-Development (VGC) method. A paint program for systems: the human paints actors, components, stores, gates and flows on a canvas; the AI and the gated process implement them. Gamification is grounded — elements glow verified only when a named oracle is recorded, and quests (the VGC stages) complete only with typed evidence. The painting serializes into every AI prompt as a manifest. AAB records the user's original intent for continuity/audit/gap-analysis, scopes work across the domains described by the ISIC/ISCO/ISCED classifications (the domains, not the standards), and offers an execution-tier ladder from browser to notebooks to local Linux to WSL. Part of the Zistgah ecosystem. Sprint 1a (v0.2).
